content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Aurora

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's official requirements to verify your qualifications before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Bootcamp. You'll complete the full PMI-required contact hours through interactive online sessions led by active certified practitioners, on a schedule that fits your Aurora-area work commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your bootcamp coursework, complete your official PMI application with proof of your education and project experience. Submit payment of the exam fee directly to PMI to activate your eligibility window and secure your testing appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to sharpen your knowledge. When ready, take the computer-based PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in or near Aurora on your scheduled date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After you earn your credential, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through PMI-approved activities, training, and project work. Plan early to meet your renewal deadline and keep your credential active throughout your career.
